from pathlib import Path

b += b'\xff\xdb\x00\x43\x00' + bytes([0]*64)
# SOF0 with max H=4,V=4 and component 1 H=3,V=2 (fractional ratio 4/3 and 2)
b += b'\xff\xc0\x00\x11\x08\x00\x10\x00\x10\x03\x01\x32\x00\x02\x11\x00\x03\x11\x00'
# DHT tables for DC/AC, one symbol each

b += b'\xff\xc4\x00\x14\x10' + bytes([0]*16) + b'\x00'
# SOS
b += b'\xff\xda\x00\x0c\x03\x01\x00\x02\x11\x03\x11\x00\x3f\x00'
# entropy-coded data: a few zero bytes then EOI
b += b'\x00'*8 + b'\xff\xd9'
p.write_bytes(b)
print(len(b))
